title: Annotatio VI §.III: Reformed desire and open door to one Church — fraternity with all keeping the Foundation
pass_a_gloss: there would be desire among the Reformed, and the door of coalescing into one Church with the same would be judged most open — namely under this Condition: that they are most ready to join the right hand of Spiritual fraternity with all who keep the Foundation of the Christian Faith, both Practical and Theoretical.
pass_b_english: The Reformed would then desire it, and the door into one church with them would be judged wide open.
The condition is simple: they stand most ready to give the right hand of spiritual fraternity to everyone who keeps the Foundation of the Christian faith — practical and theoretical alike.
source_text: Reformatis cupido esset, inque unam Ecclesiam cum iisdem coalescendi apertissima judicaretur janua, utpote sub hac Conditione, cum omnibus Fundamentum Fidei Christianae, tam Practica, quàm Theoretica servantibus dextram fraternitatis Spiritualis jungere quam paratissimis.
notes: Reformed desire; janua to one Church; Foundation practical+theoretical.
